basics.name: Mahir Afser Pavel
basics.label: AI Researcher & Graduate Assistant Candidate
basics.summary: An AI researcher with a strong research interest in medical image analysis and 70+ citations in 5 Q1 and solo Q2 journal publications, 4 of which are SCIE and 2 ESCI, holding an h-index and i10-index of 2.

highlights: Engineered Fed-GAN-DE-CL, a federated generative adversarial network for decentralized brain tumor classification while preserving patient privacy.
Developed SLGRA-Net, a structure-aware latent graph reasoning model for 3D brain tumor MRI segmentation with improved boundary delineation.
Built an uncertainty-aware diabetic retinopathy grading framework using Monte Carlo Dropout and Grad-CAM for explainable diagnostics.
Co-developed real-time drone-based fire detection frameworks using knowledge-distilled lightweight deep models for edge deployment.
Optimized YOLOv8n deployment on Raspberry Pi 5 edge devices and improved detection accuracy under dynamic outdoor conditions.
Developed CLKD-MED, a cross-lingual knowledge distillation framework for multilingual clinical outcome prediction using EHR data.
Mapped semantic clinical representations across languages to improve predictive modeling in multilingual healthcare settings.
